Overview

Békéscsaba is a city in Békés with a population of 58,002. A city on the Great Plain in southeastern Hungary, known for its Slovak minority heritage, the Csaba Sausage Festival, and agricultural traditions. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
